Name: Hide Trinkets In Cutscenes
Author: vapor64
Description:
[size=6][b]Hide Trinkets In Cutscenes[/b][/size][size=5]

[/size][size=3]No more out of place trinket companions jumping around in serious, heartfelt cutscenes. This mod that hides trinket companions(fairy, frog, parrot) in cutscenes. Note that the hair color effect of magic hair gel still remains active.

Please consider endorsing this mod if you find it helpful.

[size=3][b][u]Mod Compatibility :
[/u][/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3]Works with mods based on the Trinket Tinker framework[/size]
[/list]
[b][u]Installation :[/u][/b][b][u]
[/u][/b][list]
[*]Download latest mod file
e.g. "HideTrinketsInCutscenes1.0.0.zip"[*]Extract the contents of the mod file to your Stardew Valley mods folder
e.g. "[i]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\"[/i][*]Launch Stardew Valley using SMAPI
[/list]
[b][u]Compatibility :
[/u][/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3]Tested on Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.1[/size]
[*][size=3]Not tested on Android yet[/size]
[/list][size=3]
